learner_operation: Recall first-index row/second-index column, locate one requested entry from a complete 2x2 integer matrix, enter that integer.

fixed_features.feature: Two-by-two integer matrix, one valid a_ij and one blank.
fixed_features.justification: Explicit target lesson scope and response endpoint, not accidental original parameter values.

fixed_features.feature: No row/column reminder or marked cell before feedback.
fixed_features.justification: Independent practice retains index recall and spatial choice; the method is explained only in solutions.

fixed_features.feature: Single-, two-, and three-digit nonzero ranges plus zero by band.
fixed_features.justification: Authored readability progression with the same method, not empirical calibration or source-imposed numeric boundaries. Zero and repeated values remain legitimate simplifications.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All four positions are supported by fixture-q11/q12/q21/q22.
answer_roles.observed: Sampler uses independent radix-4 position digit for every integer-matrix code; final questions and 600 ordinary cases vary positions without label/value-derived assignment.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positive, negative and zero supported, with no distinctness/sign quotas.
answer_roles.observed: The selected integer varies with the independently sampled matrix. Zero and repeated-value cases pass explicit controls; each band bank contains zero and both signs.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: May vary while leaving the response unchanged.
answer_roles.observed: Actual controlled nonselected-cell edits preserve the answer. Unselected variation alone is not counted as new assessed work.

coverage.case: easy ordinary path and final delivery
coverage.result: All 3 delivered records preserve independent index recall and row/column lookup with one blank. Single-digit signed entries and zero simplify reading, not the required decisions. The negative diagonal and two positive off-diagonal cases were individually inspected. The CLI samples without replacement; all final records and 200 fresh records in this band survive delivery.

coverage.case: moderate ordinary path and final delivery
coverage.result: All 5 delivered records require exactly the same lookup and blank as easy. Two-digit signed integers modestly increase reading/transcription demand; there is no extra calculation. This authored moderate label has no empirical calibration. Three selected representatives cover positive/negative results and diagonal/off-diagonal targets; other negative off-diagonal records have the same work and layout. The CLI samples without replacement; all final records and 200 fresh records in this band survive delivery.

coverage.case: hard ordinary path and final delivery
coverage.result: All 5 delivered records preserve the same index recall, location and one-integer endpoint. Three-digit values add modest transcription demand only; no arithmetic, new matrix operation or response conversion is added. Labels are authored and uncalibrated. All current results happen to be negative. Fresh hard samples include 108 positive targets out of 200; none of that draw has a zero target. Zero support is established by code and explicit/native edge controls, without a sign quota. The CLI samples without replacement; all final records and 200 fresh records in this band survive delivery.

counterfactuals.change: Increment the selected cell while fixing the target and other entries.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt, key and solution must change to the replacement integer.
counterfactuals.observed: All three band-specific package calls agree with independent parsing and native acceptance/wrong controls.
counterfactuals.justification: Direct dependency of entry lookup on selected cell only. These invoke the actual generate API, alongside separately tested ordinary sampling and delivery.

counterfactuals.change: Increment an unselected cell while fixing the target and requested value.
counterfactuals.expected: Matrix given changes; requested integer, key and solution endpoint remain unchanged.
counterfactuals.observed: All three band-specific package calls agree with independent parsing and native acceptance/wrong controls.
counterfactuals.justification: Direct dependency of entry lookup on selected cell only. These invoke the actual generate API, alongside separately tested ordinary sampling and delivery.

shortcut_applicability.reason: Positional/value/sign cues can be tested from the displayed matrix. Choice-bank/rank probes do not apply to a free-entry blank.

shortcut_probes.subgroup: All 600 ordinary fresh sampled matrices, after identical-content delivery.
shortcut_probes.strategy: Allowed information is the displayed matrix only. Read upper-right value and ignore a_ij.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 153/600 correct on fresh ordinary cases; not a reliable substitute for the requested lookup. Baseline is uniform choice among four displayed cells, accounting for coincident values. No generalized guarantee or confirmed defect is claimed. Final-batch diagnostics are retained separately, including hard minimum 4/5 and unique-negative 1/1; these small observations do not establish a construction defect.

shortcut_probes.conclusion: 151/600 correct on fresh ordinary cases; not a reliable substitute for the requested lookup. shortcut_probes.subgroup: Only fresh matrices with exactly one negative displayed cell, selected without looking at target/key.
shortcut_probes.strategy: Allowed information is cell values/signs only. Count negatives to select subgroup and output its sole negative value, bypassing requested indices; target/key used only to score after prediction.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 37/153 correct on fresh ordinary cases; not a reliable substitute for the requested lookup. Baseline is uniform choice among four displayed cells, accounting for coincident values. No generalized guarantee or confirmed defect is claimed. Final-batch diagnostics are retained separately, including hard minimum 4/5 and unique-negative 1/1; these small observations do not establish a construction defect.

stages_examined: uniform no-replacement complete-instance sampler; no rejection/resampling branch
read-only inspection of difficulty-first learner selection implementation
delivery.result: All 13 final and 600 fresh ordinary samples survive delivery. No sign/position/value-specific guard is used. Selection code groups fresh candidates by difficulty and hashes to choose within a band, without inspecting matrix values or target positions. Live learner history/weights and publication are outside this offline test.

limitations: Moderate/hard are authored, uncalibrated reading demands; identical reasoning across bands is intentional.
Diagnostic samples cannot exclude every shortcut. Source-supported repeated values or constant matrices can legitimately reduce discrimination of location work; they are not excluded.
Finite caps count distinct visible matrix-and-target instances, not a claimed number of mastered subskills. No complete finite catalog or exhaustion is asserted.
No database, learner snapshot, publication, registration, service restart or live availability test was authorized. Source and learner-state integrity are preserved by offline operation.
